title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women, from Lombardy and Abruzzo. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold them in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Emilia Bianchi
tribute: Emilia Bianchi was 70 years old and lived in Palosco. She was a mother of three. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: Dora Caserio
tribute: Dora Caserio was 87 years old. Her family came from Montenero di Bisaccia, and she was a wife and a mother. She is in our thoughts.
